info.title: BNBU Sports Unified API
info.summary: Unified contract for the sports check-in platform
info.description:
Cross-client compatibility candidate derived from the immutable published 1.4.0
snapshot. It does not prove that every registered capability is
business-enabled or production-ready.
Business fields come from 02-data-dictionary.md, state transitions from
03-state-machines.md, rules from 04-business-rules.md, and authorization
from 05-permission-matrix.md. Foundation authentication/session persistence
is approved; CourseInvite/Join Capability are contract-and-persistence-design
only until the Enrollment Gate, while every Export operation is fail-closed
and V1 persists no ExportJob. Of the 30 client-support operations added in
Stage 21, authentication, exemption, release-policy, notification,
push-device, preference, help, and feedback capabilities are approved for
real local implementation, while unresolved capabilities remain explicit
routed denials. GPS has persistence and
application-layer foundations, but all six location HTTP operations remain
denied. None of these statements proves Staging, iOS-binary, push-delivery,
GPS-production, or Production-Gate readiness.

x-authorization-invariants.teacherScope: ClassSection.teacherId must equal principal.teacherId; no assignment or inferred multi-teacher relation exists.
x-authorization-invariants.rawAuditLogRead: ADMIN within the same organization only; TEACHER is denied.
x-authorization-invariants.defaultDeny: Student enrollment withdrawal, submitted-record withdrawal, roster ignore, archived-score correction, Export, four client authentication/recovery operations, six exemption operations, sport catalog, activity conversion, and six GPS/location operations are explicit routed denials. Twelve Stage 21 client-support operations are local-integration implementations only and are not Staging or production enablement. Student Course/ClassSection projection remains denied until an ACTIVE Enrollment can be resolved.

post.summary: Validate student profile data and issue a short-lived one-time Join Capability
post.description: This public bootstrap step intentionally runs before an Access Token exists. The plaintext capability is returned once. Persistence stores only an irreversible digest, its target ClassSection, a normalized profile digest, status, and configured expiry. Previously verified students must authenticate and use the member capability endpoint; this public route returns 401 for that identity.

post.summary: Consume a Join Capability and atomically establish the student session
post.description: No ordinary Access Token is accepted because this is the pre-authentication enrollment bootstrap. One transaction consumes the capability and creates or reuses User, StudentProfile, ACTIVE Enrollment, and AuthSession; a new student is returned as PENDING_CONTACT_BINDING and the client must complete email verification before any protected sports operation. Any failure rolls back all effects.

post.summary: Start the authenticated student's authoritative exercise session
post.description: Student starts a server-timed session. Before the published regular deadline use ordinary course windows; after it require an accepted, currently open, unrevoked makeup grant for this enrollment. Recheck current semester, active course and member, system mode and absence of another active session. Store the makeup source atomically and preserve actual server business date; grant expiry or revocation never rewrites an existing session.

Request an organization-scoped student sign-in challenge
post.description: Creates a single-use, rate-limited challenge and returns an enumeration-safe challenge identifier. Delivery is available only through an explicitly configured provider; production has no universal code.

post.summary: Verify a student sign-in challenge and establish an AuthSession
post.description: Consumes a valid single-use challenge and reuses the existing JWT, refresh-token rotation, session revocation, AuditLog, and Outbox boundary. Students do not receive or create passwords.

post.summary: Request a TEACHER or ADMIN password-recovery challenge
post.description: Creates an organization-scoped, enumeration-safe recovery challenge for TEACHER or ADMIN only. STUDENT password recovery is not supported because students authenticate with OTP.

post.summary: Complete a TEACHER or ADMIN password-recovery challenge
post.description: Consumes one challenge, replaces the password hash, increments tokenVersion, and revokes existing sessions and refresh tokens. STUDENT recovery identifiers are always rejected.

get.summary: List own feedback or organization governance feedback according to role

post.description: Creates a privacy-bounded feedback item with domain history, AuditLog, and Outbox evidence. It does not upload logs or create an external support ticket.

get.description: Returns feedback only to its creator or an ADMIN in the same organization.

get.summary: List role-scoped exemption applications with lossless structured details
get.description: Additive Contract 1.5 read model for updated clients. It preserves exact 800m/1000m or school-team/student-club subtype and independent organizationName while returning null for pre-migration legacy applications.

get.summary: List own, responsible-class, or organization-governance exemption applications
get.description: STUDENT reads own applications, TEACHER reads applications for personally assigned ClassSections, and ADMIN receives organization-governance projections. All roles receive the same public application projection.

post.summary: Create a student-owned exemption application draft
post.description: Creates a DRAFT owned by the authenticated student and atomically associates eligible private EXEMPTION_APPLICATION media from the same active Enrollment. applicationSubtype preserves the exact 800m/1000m or school-team/student-club business meaning; organizationName is required only for school-team and student-club applications.

get.description: Resolves student ownership, responsible-teacher ClassSection scope, or ADMIN organization scope before returning the public projection. internalNote is never projected.

patch.summary: Update an owned draft or supplement-requested application
patch.description: Updates only an owned DRAFT or SUPPLEMENT_REQUIRED application using expectedVersion and atomically replaces eligible private attachment associations. Updated subtype and organization fields must remain compatible with the immutable applicationType.

post.summary: Submit an owned exemption application for responsible-teacher review
post.description: Moves an owned DRAFT or SUPPLEMENT_REQUIRED application to SUBMITTED for the one responsible ClassSection teacher. PHYSICAL_TEST and EXERCISE_CHECK_IN applications require at least one AVAILABLE private attachment before submission. Submission does not directly change Score facts.

get.summary: Get a platform-specific persisted minimum-version policy
get.description: Returns the currently effective persisted policy. For IOS, enforcement is derived from numeric currentBuildNumber against minimum/latest build thresholds; marketing version strings are display-only. Policy publication, signing, rollout, and production values remain separately governed.

ExerciseSession.description: Ordinary projection omits clientObservedDurationSeconds and deviceSessionId.

recordOrigin.description: LIVE for timer sessions, HISTORICAL for student-declared backfill requiring teacher review.

StudentCurrentReview.description: Student-safe projection of the highest reviewVersion only. It never contains reason, internalNote, storage keys, or review history.

description.description: Student-authored explanation. Required and nonblank for GENERAL; optional for COURSE_RELATED, where omitted, null, or blank input is normalized to null.
Omit to preserve the current value. Null or blank is accepted only when the resulting creditType is COURSE_RELATED.

mediaIds.description: Ordered private evidence identifiers. Each access still requires the role-scoped media access-url operation.
Complete set of AVAILABLE EXERCISE_RECORD media captured in-app for this session. Omitting any eligible item is rejected.

mimeType.description: Untrusted transport declaration. The server verifies the actual bytes and container; clients must not substitute video/mp4 when the browser reports an empty or different MIME.

fileSizeBytes.description: Exact upload length used for transport integrity. No business maximum applies to EXERCISE_RECORD VIDEO.

captureSource.description: EXERCISE_RECORD requires IN_APP_CAMERA. EXEMPTION_APPLICATION permits IN_APP_CAMERA or FILE_PICKER; SYSTEM_IMPORT is not accepted by this student endpoint.

declaredContentSha256.description: Optional and untrusted client declaration; it is not an integrity fact.

durationSeconds.description: Required and positive for VIDEO; omit or null for IMAGE. EXERCISE_RECORD VIDEO has a fixed maximum of 15 cumulative recorded seconds; pauses are excluded. Runtime validation enforces the media-type and purpose conditions.

InitiateMediaUploadRequest.description: EXERCISE_RECORD media is scoped to an owned ExerciseSession. EXEMPTION_APPLICATION media is scoped to an owned active Enrollment before atomic association with an application draft. No location permission or GPS data is required; uploaded JPEG/PNG/ISO/WebM media containing recognized location metadata is rejected.

declaredMimeType.description: Untrusted client declaration captured at initiation. Exercise-record video format is not a business limit.

verifiedMimeType.description: Null until trusted byte-level processing succeeds.

declaredFileSizeBytes.description: Untrusted client declaration captured at initiation. It is a transport and integrity fact; exercise-record video has no business size maximum.

verifiedFileSizeBytes.description: Null until the private object is read and validated by the server.

captureSource.description: EXERCISE_RECORD requires IN_APP_CAMERA. EXEMPTION_APPLICATION permits IN_APP_CAMERA or FILE_PICKER; SYSTEM_IMPORT is not accepted by this student endpoint.

verifiedContentSha256.description: The only public integrity hash; written only after trusted byte-level validation succeeds and null beforehand.

declaredDurationSeconds.description: Untrusted client declaration; required for VIDEO and null for IMAGE. EXERCISE_RECORD VIDEO is limited to 15 cumulative recorded seconds.

verifiedDurationSeconds.description: Trusted parsed duration for VIDEO and null for IMAGE or before processing; this value finally enforces the 15-second exercise-video cap.

safeMetadata.description: Verified dimensions and allowlisted camera EXIF facts only; absent tags have no data. Never includes GPS, owner identity or device serial numbers.

MediaEvidence.description: Declared and verified facts are intentionally distinct. storageKey and thumbnailStorageKey are never exposed.

BindMediaRequest.description: Stage 15 permits only binding to the same owned ExerciseSession. recordId is deliberately absent until ExerciseRecord exists.

StudentSignInCodeRequest.description: Organization-scoped input. The response never reveals whether a STUDENT account exists.

StudentSignInCodeAccepted.description: Enumeration-safe acceptance projection; it contains no account, contact, or delivery-provider data.

AccountRecoveryRequest.description: Enumeration-safe recovery request for pre-provisioned TEACHER or ADMIN accounts only.

AccountRecoveryAccepted.description: Enumeration-safe acceptance projection; it contains no account, contact, or delivery-provider data.

Notification.description: Role-owned projection only; delivery provider metadata and arbitrary payloads are excluded.

HelpArticle.description: Published content only; embedded active HTML, scripts, and arbitrary remote resources are not allowed.

Feedback.description: Safe business projection; raw logs, tokens, contacts, device fingerprints, and internal support notes are excluded.

clientContext.description: Allowlisted diagnostics only; no free-form headers, logs, tokens, contacts, or device identifiers.

applicationSubtype.description: Null identifies a legacy application whose subtype cannot be inferred safely.

organizationName.description: Required for SCHOOL_TEAM and STUDENT_CLUB; null for endurance-run, special-circumstance, and legacy applications.

StructuredExemptionApplication.description: Additive role-safe projection for updated clients. It excludes teacher identity, internalNote, storageKey, and signed media URLs.

ExemptionApplication.description: Role-safe projection. Teacher identity, internalNote, medical details beyond the student's submitted reason, and signed media URLs are excluded.

applicationSubtype.description: Updated Contract 1.5 clients send this field. RUN_800M/RUN_1000M require PHYSICAL_TEST; SCHOOL_TEAM/STUDENT_CLUB require EXERCISE_CHECK_IN; SPECIAL_CIRCUMSTANCE requires the matching applicationType. Omission is accepted only for backward-compatible legacy clients and persists null.

organizationName.description: Updated Contract 1.5 clients send a name for SCHOOL_TEAM and STUDENT_CLUB and null otherwise. Omission is accepted only with an omitted applicationSubtype for backward-compatible legacy clients.

minimumSupportedBuildNumber.description: Required for IOS and compared numerically. Null for platforms without an approved numeric build policy.

latestBuildNumber.description: Required for IOS and compared numerically. Marketing version text is not used as a substitute.

AppReleasePolicy.description: For IOS, enforcement is REQUIRED below minimumSupportedBuildNumber, RECOMMENDED below latestBuildNumber, and NONE otherwise.

ClientErrorReportRequest.description: Closed, redacted client telemetry metadata. Arbitrary text, stack traces, request bodies, URLs with query strings, and attachments are intentionally unsupported.

x-android-handoff.selection: STUDENT allowedRoles plus explicit public authentication, invite, help and system operations; excluded legacy location, push, self-deletion and withdrawal; role access is not feature availability
